# telnyx_phone_number_block_jobs (Data Source)

The background jobs that release phone number blocks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_status` (String) Identifies the status of the background job. One of `completed`, `failed`, `in_progress`, `pending`.
- `filter_type` (String) Identifies the type of the background job. One of `delete_phone_number_block`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `phone_number_block_jobs` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_block_jobs))
